text:
name: T16 discovery census capture (reuse verified engines)
on:
  push:
    branches: ['diag/wasm-discovery-census-capture-20261004']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
jobs:
  guest:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          repository: CrispStrobe/bw-board
          ref: d1f2c8ebfc5e4e76d5fc81f930588c13de13e974
          path: board
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with: {node-version: '22.23.3'}
      - run: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends gcc-arm-none-eabi binutils-arm-none-eabi
      - run: node .github/scripts/build-t16-census-guest.mjs board
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: t16-discovery-shared-guest
          path: shared-guest
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
  capture:
    needs: guest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: {leg: [off, a, b]}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          repository: CrispStrobe/bw-board
          ref: d1f2c8ebfc5e4e76d5fc81f930588c13de13e974
          path: board
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with: {node-version: '22.23.3'}
      - name: Pure frozen-text transformation tests
        run: node --test .github/scripts/t16-census-harness.test.mjs
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with: {name: t16-discovery-shared-guest, path: shared-guest}
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          name: t16-discovery-census-${{ matrix.leg }}
          path: captures/t16-discovery-census-${{ matrix.leg }}
          run-id: 37201401969
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Verify source, original failed gate, build and all108 proofs before reuse
        env: {GITHUB_TOKEN: '${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}', LEG: '${{ matrix.leg }}'}
        run: node .github/scripts/prepare-t16-census-capture.mjs "$LEG"
      - name: Install actual guest dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends gcc-arm-none-eabi binutils-arm-none-eabi
          cd board
          npm ci
      - name: Five shared-guest diagnostic windows, NOT RTx qualification
        env:
          LEG: ${{ matrix.leg }}
          LABWIRED_T16_CENSUS_GUEST: ${{ github.workspace }}/shared-guest/motion.elf
        run: |
          mode=on
          if [ "$LEG" = off ]; then mode=off; fi
          node .github/scripts/capture-t16-census.mjs board "$(< engine-directory.txt)" "$mode"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: t16-discovery-census-capture-${{ matrix.leg }}
          path: |
            census-*.json
            census-*.txt
            artifact-reuse.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
  equivalence:
    needs: capture
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with: {node-version: '22.23.3'}
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          pattern: t16-discovery-census-*
          path: captures
          run-id: 37201401969
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with: {pattern: 't16-discovery-census-capture-*', path: new-captures}
      - name: Compare first captures, original engine bytes and guest observations
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for leg in off a b; do
            cp "new-captures/t16-discovery-census-capture-$leg/census-capture.json" "captures/t16-discovery-census-$leg/"
          done
          node .github/scripts/verify-t16-census.mjs captures
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: t16-discovery-census-capture-equivalence
          path: census-equivalence.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
